definitions.label: processed `capacity` = raw `summary.discharge_capacity_Ah` (Ah; the library function get_capacity() takes the 2nd field of the summary struct)
definitions.stage_split: each cycle is split by relative_time_min == 0 into [charge, rest, discharge, rest] (Batch-6 satellite data has only 3 segments: charge/rest/discharge) -- from the publisher preprocessing library get_partial_value()
definitions.CC: in the charge stage, data with voltage >= 4.199 V **and** current > 3.9 A (library comment: the CV-stage voltage is sometimes below 4.199, hence the intersection with current) -- get_CC_value()
definitions.CV: in the charge stage, the part outside the CC condition (divided by current threshold) -- get_CV_value()
definitions.source: github.com/wang-fujin/Battery-dataset-preprocessing-code-library/XJTUBatteryClass.py (publisher code, fetched 2026-09-22; this repository does not redistribute it)
definitions.caveat: the definitions above come from the publisher's **code**; the column-by-column correspondence of the processed CSV columns (CC Q / CV Q / CC charge time / CV charge time) still awaits the curve cross-check (this script's align_* verifies the capacity column only)
